summary: Agent roster refreshes classify at most 4096 claim rows per delta and assemble large rosters through resumable subject-keyset pages. Each background roster snapshot has a two-second cooperative wall deadline. Completed pages survive cancelled attempts; queue and visibility metadata are diffed without discarding completed cards, while timed-out delta pages independently shrink. Bounded claim and local-timeline reconciliation certifies the assembled roster at one final cut before replacing the previous complete publication.

replay.detail: No persisted projection replay. Overflow rebuilds only the in-memory roster cache from the complete current cut.

rules.detail: No membership, invalidation, retention or checkpoint policy change.

compatibility.detail: No client or wire change. A refresh that exhausts its deadline retains the previous publication and resumes its saved membership/delta cursors on the next attempt.
